# splunkctl server

Server operations — messages, license, KV store, topology health.

## server cluster

Indexer cluster health — mode, peers, SF/RF status.

```text
splunkctl server cluster [OPTIONS]
```

```text
On a non-clustered instance, reports mode=disabled and exits 0.
Prefers the ``cluster/manager`` endpoint (Splunk 9+); falls back
to ``cluster/master`` on older versions.
```

## server deployment

Deployment server clients — count, last check-in.

```text
splunkctl server deployment [OPTIONS]
```

```text
If no clients are registered (or the deployment server feature is
not enabled), reports a clean status and exits 0.
```

## server health

Component-level splunkd health report (scheduler, disk, KV store...).

```text
splunkctl server health [OPTIONS]
```

```text
Flattens the health-report feature tree into one row per component;
nested feature names join with " / ". This command reports — it does
not gate: red components still exit 0.
```

## server kvstore

Show KV store status.

```text
splunkctl server kvstore [OPTIONS]
```

## server license

Show license pool usage, or daily volume and expiry with --usage.

```text
splunkctl server license [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--usage` | flag | false | Today's indexed volume vs quota and soonest license expiry. |

## server messages

List system messages, or dismiss one with --dismiss NAME --yes.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl server messages [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dismiss` | text | - | Delete a message by name. |

## server search-peers

Distributed-search peers — status, replication, version.

```text
splunkctl server search-peers [OPTIONS]
```

```text
Lists every search peer this instance fans searches out to. Empty on
a standalone instance (exit 0).
```

## server shcluster

Search head cluster health — captain, members, replication.

```text
splunkctl server shcluster [OPTIONS]
```

```text
On a non-SHC instance, reports mode=disabled and exits 0.
```

## server tokens create

Create an auth token. The token value is shown ONCE.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl server tokens create [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--user` | text | - | Username to issue the token for. [required] |
| `--audience` | text | - | Token audience claim. |
| `--expires-in` | integer | - | Token lifetime in days (omit for non-expiring). |

## server tokens list

List auth tokens, optionally filtered by user.

```text
splunkctl server tokens list [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--user` | text | - | Filter by username. |

## server tokens revoke

Revoke (delete) an auth token by its ID.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl server tokens revoke [OPTIONS] TOKEN_ID
```
